title: Transport of the diagonal insertion across the canonical square
statement:
Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell and a scheme S where ell is invertible. Let p be a normalized projective-line tower Presentation, d its Maps and h its EtaleOriginComparisonsWithLine, as in [lem-sp-tower-p1-etale-origin-comparisons]. All words below are the actual derived tensor, projection and mate words of [def-sp-tower-p1-triangle-words]. The precise assertion is:
theorem towerP1DiagonalTransport (p : Presentation l E S hS) (d : Maps l E p)
    (h : EtaleOriginComparisonsWithLine l E p d) :
    (∀ M : C l E p.classes.base (ProjectiveLine S),
      (p.F l E).map (unitInsertion l E d M) ≫
        (p.pushSwap l E).hom.app
          ((SpTowerShriek.tensor l E p.classes.base (diagonalSurface S)).obj
            ((SpTowerShriek.pull l E p.classes.base
              (p.operations.geometry (pullback.fst _ _))).obj M.obj,
              (line l E p.classes.chernW)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)) =
      (p.F l E).map (diagonalInsertion l E h false M)) ∧
    (∀ K : C l E p.classes.base S,
      unitInsertion l E d ((rightRestricted l E d).obj K) ≫
        (SpTowerShriek.push l E p.classes.base
          (p.operations.geometry (pullback.snd _ _))).map
            ((SpTowerShriek.tensor l E p.classes.base (diagonalSurface S)).map
              (Prod.mkHom (rightPullComparison l E p K.obj).hom (𝟙 _))) =
      diagonalInsertion l E h true ((rightRestricted l E d).obj K))

proof.text: the sourceUnit and sourceUnitAt maps are the composite adjunction units for p_i Delta=identity, formed using the specified diagonalPull comparison. For the first equation, paste the q/p_i pullback squares with the section square of Delta. The two pasted pullback comparisons agree by the termwise composition normalization in Operations.comp_termwise and the ordinary inverse-image composition law. Their right conjugates agree by mate pasting, giving the source comparison after pushSwap. Naturality of this conjugate for the inverse diagonal projection, delta tensor identity, and the symmetry moves pushSwap to the end of the insertion, yielding the first equation. For the second, restrict rightPullComparison along Delta. Both p_i Delta are the specified identity. Its q*K factor is identity by the same pasting law, and its line factor is identity because line1Iso was defined from the same square and line2Iso. Therefore inverse supported projection for p1 and for p2 is intertwined by tensoring with rightPullComparison. Projection naturality and symmetry naturality move that tensor map across delta tensor identity, leaving exactly sourceUnitAt true and diagonalProjectionInverse true. This proves the second equation. All identities are in the tower derived category; the argument uses ordinary sheaf normalization before localization, never faithfulness of evaluation on arbitrary derived morphisms.
